Priya (CS): Hi team — kicking off Axion onboarding orienteering. Quick context: Axion Health wants Redwood for clinical note summarization in their care-management workflow. Goal is a pilot in ~4 weeks. I'm starting this thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, enablement, and renewal risks.

Jordan (AE): +1 from sales. Riley is the PM on their side and will join. Their security lead is watching PHI handling.

Riley (PM, Axion): Thanks — we want a clean pilot: integrated summaries in our triage UI, daily quality checks, and a go/no-go decision after the pilot week. Weekly check-ins preferred.

Ethan (Solutions): Heads-up — to size Dedicated or Private we need expected qps and token distribution. @Priya can you capture throughput expectations and a sample payload?

Priya (CS): Sure — asking Riley for sample traffic. Proposed success criteria (draft): 1) p95 latency < 200ms for summary endpoint during pilot; 2) automated eval accuracy >= 85% on their clinical extract set; 3) cost <= $0.015 per 1k tokens during pilot; 4) zero PII leakage incidents; 5) 2x weekly engineering touchpoints. Will formalize in Confluence. :memo:

Taylor (SE): I can run the API deep-dive and prompt engineering session for their devs. Suggest Tues 10am PT. I also need a service account in their tenant with role `redwood-integration` (security will need that scoped).

Lee (Eng): Note: Axion will likely require VPC/private deployment or our Private offering because of PHI. Jordan — please flag legal for BAA + SOC2. That impacts timeline and infra setup.

Jordan (AE): Will escalate. Contract team already flagged BAA + SOC2; renewal risk noted: if latency/cost are off, they may pause after pilot.

Priya (CS): For account health we'll track: weekly active devs, successful requests/day, median latency, percent prompts passing eval. Also plan to capture qualitative feedback after each enablement session.

Ethan (Solutions): Action items: 1) Riley to share sample payload & expected qps (this week); 2) Taylor to schedule enablement + send slide deck; 3) Priya to draft success criteria & Confluence page; 4) Jordan to loop in legal/contract.

Riley (PM, Axion): I'll share payload and a small eval set by EOD Thu. Also want a runbook for regression alerts during pilot.

OnboardBot: Reminder — meeting scheduled: "Axion onboarding orienteering" • 2023-12-05 10:00 PST (calendar invite sent).

Priya (CS): Great. I'll create the Confluence doc and a lightweight tracking board for weekly OKRs. If anyone has objections to the success criteria above, speak now — otherwise I'll mark them as draft and share. :rocket:
